prompt: Make a character sprite for my game in this image's exact art style: high resolution shaded pixel art, gritty, dark and desaturated, muted colors, same lighting and same top-down three-quarter camera angle and same character scale as the reference. It is an enemy of the undead lich's army: a soldier of the holy human crusade, a direct foil to the undead. Worn, battle-scarred ivory and tarnished gold, weathered steel, off-white cloth stained with mud and soot, deep crimson trim, and soft warm holy-light glows (pale candle gold) where the undead have necrotic green; still muted and gritty enough to sit on the same dark battlefield. The character is an Angel of the Host: a winged warrior angel with large ivory and pale gold feathered wings, a plain gold helm hiding the face, ivory robes over light gold mail, holding a spear of pale golden light. Full body, hovering above the ground over its own faint shadow, facing right. It is the ONLY character, standing alone in an open, empty patch of the dark battlefield ground with nothing touching or overlapping it, fully visible with clear space around it. Not a cartoon, not bright, no saturated colors.
